POST_DISABLE_404_ROOT_CAUSE.question: trace the POST /disable call to its source and service
POST_DISABLE_404_ROOT_CAUSE.FINDING: there is no call site. The endpoint was INVENTED in a scratch script written during cycle 116. It never existed in this repository and is not a documented Gumroad route.
evidence: channels/gumroad_publisher.py documents exactly one publish-state route: PUT /v2/products/:id/enable
the string 'disable' does not appear anywhere in gumroad_publisher.py
a live probe of POST /v2/products/<id>/disable returned HTTP 404 with Gumroad's HTML 'Page not found' page, not a JSON API error - i.e. the route does not exist on the service
Gumroad API base is https://api.gumroad.com/v2 and auth was correct in the same script; reads from the same base and token worked, so neither prefix nor auth was the fault
POST_DISABLE_404_ROOT_CAUSE.classification: the route does not exist on the service. Not a wrong path, not a wrong verb, not an auth failure.
POST_DISABLE_404_ROOT_CAUSE.no_verb_swapping: POST was NOT swapped for GET or DELETE to make a 404 disappear. That would have been guessing.
POST_DISABLE_404_ROOT_CAUSE.no_phantom_route: no fake endpoint was created to make the operation appear to work.

DOCUMENTED_MECHANISM_ATTEMPTED_AND_PROVE.mechanism: PUT /v2/products/<id> with published=false - the only documented write that could plausibly unpublish
DOCUMENTED_MECHANISM_ATTEMPTED_AND_PROVE.result: HTTP 200, and published remained True. Price 15000 cents and 0 files unchanged. The public page /l/owtmpe still returns 200 and is still purchasable.
DOCUMENTED_MECHANISM_ATTEMPTED_AND_PROVE.why_it_matters: this is the same silent no-op already proven for the description field on this exact product in cycle 116. HTTP 200 from Gumroad is NOT evidence that a write landed.
DOCUMENTED_MECHANISM_ATTEMPTED_AND_PROVE.CONCLUSION: Gumroad's public API offers enable but NO way to unpublish or delete a product.
DOCUMENTED_MECHANISM_ATTEMPTED_AND_PROVE.no_false_success_claim: the product was NOT declared unpublished. Its verified state after every attempt is published=True with 0 files.
